entities.summary: Buzurg ibn Shahriyār al-Rāmhurmuzī was a 10th-century Persian merchant captain from Ramhormoz. He penned a collection of stories in Arabic, entitled ʿAjāʾib al-Hind. The latest datable story in the collection is from 953. His 134 narratives were from Muslim sailors and traders based in Siraf, Oman, Basra and elsewhere.
